messages:
mike: Heads up — planning a canary for runtime v2.4 + router header-split in tonight's quiet window (02:00 UTC). Need API + Console pin and rollback criteria. Pinging @sara @lin @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploybot: reservation confirmed: wave=20250312-02, window=02:00 UTC. Use /pin to lock component versions.

sara: Quick thought — console is backwards compatible with v2.4 header, could avoid pinning console initially to reduce ops overhead. We should still have a fallback route.

lin: Risk note: if console is unpinned we need header-negotiation shim for mismatched clients for the first 10% of traffic. That adds ~20-40ms p95 on our staging numbers. My preference is to pin console for the initial 5% canary only.

mike: Proposal: rollout plan => 5% for 20m, monitor, then 25% for 20m, then scale. Pin order suggestion: runtime -> router -> api -> console (console pin optional for 5% stage). Rollback triggers: error rate > 3x baseline OR p95 latency increase >= 500ms.

sara: sounds reasonable. Confirming there are no DB migrations. (there are none)

jen: I'll run the preflight checklist: health checks, schema checks, kv-eviction thresholds. Checklist items: health checks ✅, kv-clear ✅, staging smoke ✅. Rollback quick command: ```./scripts/rollback.sh --wave=$WAVE```; ops will be standing by.

mike: Also we should enable router variant fallback to v2.3 in case of KV cache mismatch. Can someone validate fallback path in staging?

lin: I'll validate fallback and run a stress smoke in staging at 21:00 PT. tagging @deploy-bot to record the run.

deploy-bot: deploybot: staging run recorded: 1709876500-staging-rt-v2.4-smoke — no regression alerts.

jen: Note: we saw a memory leak once for v2.4 under long-lived sessions. If memory trends up, immediate unpin + traffic->0% within 120s, ops will escalate to SRE.

nate: I'll watch telemetry and set a temporary alert for the canary. I'll mute noisy non-actionable alerts but keep Sev3 on.

mike: Final asks: @sara can you prepare a short release blurb + pin grant list? @lin/@jen confirm staging smoke by 21:30 PT so we can proceed.

sara: :thumbsup: I'll post release note in #release-notes in a few minutes. No objection to console staying unpinned for initial 5%?

jen: no objections from ops. I'll attach rollback command and the quick op runbook when I start the wave.

mike: Great — if all set I'll kick at 02:00 UTC and post a running update in this thread. /wave=1709876543

(ops reminder) jen: when starting, run: 
```/pin runtime v2.4 --wave=1709876543
/pin router v2.4 --wave=1709876543
/pin api v2.4 --wave=1709876543
# console optional for 5%: /pin console v2.4 --wave=1709876543
```

mike: Thanks everyone. If anything changes I’ll update.
